title: Krishna Tells Your Child's Story
shortDesc: Lord Krishna visits your child by name and shares the timeless wisdom of Bhagavatham — friendship, love and the joy of life. A divine bedtime story made just for them.
fullDesc:
Imagine your child hearing: 'Arjun, let me tell you a secret…' — spoken by Lord Krishna himself!

This personalised storybook weaves your child's name into an enchanting Krishna tale, teaching the values of friendship, unconditional love, and the beauty of being kind.

Perfect for ages 2–10 years. Every page glows with colourful illustrations and simple language your child will adore.

title: Ganesha Blesses Your Child's Journey
shortDesc: Lord Ganesha speaks your child's name and guides them through a magical adventure, teaching courage and the power of a fresh start.
fullDesc:
Ganpati Bappa says: 'Come, little one — I have a special story just for you, [Child's Name]!'

This delightful storybook features Lord Ganesha as your child's wise and fun companion. Together they solve problems, remove obstacles and celebrate new beginnings.

A wonderful gift for school admissions, birthdays, or simply to inspire your child's confidence every day.

title: Hanuman Gives Your Child Super Strength
shortDesc: Mighty Hanuman calls out your child's name and takes them on a heroic adventure, teaching bravery, devotion and the strength that lives inside every child.
fullDesc:
Jai Hanuman! He flies down and says: '[Child's Name], you are braver than you know!'

Featuring the beloved Hanuman on a colourful Ramayana-inspired adventure, this book shows your child that true strength comes from a loving heart and a never-give-up spirit.

Perfect for children who love superheroes — because Hanuman is India's greatest one!

title: Saraswathi Teaches Your Child to Shine
shortDesc: Goddess Saraswathi sits beside your child and whispers their name, sparking a love for learning, music and the gift of knowledge.
fullDesc:
Goddess Saraswathi smiles and says: 'Dear [Child's Name], you have the greatest gift — a curious mind!'

This beautiful storybook brings Saraswathi Devi to life as your child's favourite teacher. Together they explore the wonders of music, art, and the joy of learning new things every day.

Ideal before school starts or as a Saraswathi Puja gift!

title: Durga Maa Protects Your Little Warrior
shortDesc: Maa Durga reaches out to your child by name, wrapping them in her divine protection and teaching them that inner strength conquers all fears.
fullDesc:
Durga Maa says with a gentle smile: '[Child's Name], I am always with you — you are never alone!'

A powerful and comforting storybook that reassures children of Maa Durga's protection. Through a Navratri-inspired adventure, your child learns that courage lives in every heart.

A beautiful Navratri or Dussehra gift for girls and boys alike!

title: Shiva Shows Your Child the Way of Peace
shortDesc: Lord Shiva opens his eyes and calls your child's name, teaching them that true peace and power come from stillness, kindness, and a calm heart.
fullDesc:
From the peaks of Kailash, Lord Shiva opens his eyes and says: '[Child's Name], come — I have a story of stars and stillness for you…'

This magical storybook brings the gentle and powerful side of Shiva to your child — teaching mindfulness, inner calm, and how to be kind even when things are hard.

A unique, soothing bedtime story that children and parents will both love.

title: Lakshmi Brings Your Child Abundance & Gratitude
shortDesc: Goddess Lakshmi steps off her lotus and sprinkles golden blessings, teaching your child the magic of gratitude, sharing, and a giving heart.
fullDesc:
Goddess Lakshmi smiles and says: 'Dear [Child's Name], the greatest wealth is a grateful heart!'

This golden storybook weaves Lakshmi Devi's blessings into a Diwali-inspired adventure. Your child learns why sharing is the biggest treasure of all — and how a thankful heart attracts all good things.

A perfect Diwali gift and a treasure every child will return to again and again!

title: Murugan Guides Your Child to Victory
shortDesc: Lord Murugan rides his peacock and calls your child's name, taking them on a Tamil legend adventure filled with determination and the sweetness of victory.
fullDesc:
With his vel raised, Lord Murugan says: '[Child's Name], you were born to win!'

This vibrant storybook celebrates Murugan — the eternal young God of Tamil Nadu. Your child joins him on an adventure where they learn that persistence, hard work and faith always lead to victory.

A wonderful gift for families in Tamil Nadu — especially around Karthigai Deepam and Thai Pongal!

title: Rama Shows Your Child the Path of Truth
shortDesc: Lord Rama places his hand on your child's shoulder and speaks their name — guiding them through a Ramayana adventure teaching truth, honesty and the right way to live.
fullDesc:
Lord Rama smiles warmly and says: '[Child's Name], let me tell you what it truly means to be good…'

Set in the enchanting world of the Ramayana, this storybook brings Rama — the ideal human — as your child's personal guide. They learn about truth, keeping promises, and treating everyone with kindness.

A classic tale reimagined, personalised just for your child. A gift they'll treasure forever.
